# Updating projects

```bash
cd my-project
uvx copier update --trust
```

Answers live in `.copier-answers.yml`. Copier three-way merges against your tree.

## Tips

- Commit before updating
- Avoid editing protected baseline paths in product repos
- Frontend now asks `auth_mode` — older answers without it should be updated carefully
- Backend answers without `platform_profile` should set `saas` or `api` explicitly before update
